title: Social preferences with unstable interactive reasoning: Large language models in economic trust games

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' decisions as senders and receivers in economic trust games (one-shot, repeated, and probabilistic repeated) to measure their levels of trust and reciprocity, identifying deviations from purely rational, self-interested economic behavior.

Assigning varying general personas (unspecified, selfish, unselfish) to LLMs to measure how explicit role-playing prompts shape their interactive reasoning and alter their economic exchange decisions.
